title: AI Policy
description: How Dakhni.org uses artificial intelligence to compile and synthesise its content, and what that means for readers.
dedication: In memory of the Asaf Jahi dynasty
subtitle: How artificial intelligence is used to compile and synthesise the content of this archive

blocks.html:
The information on this website is compiled and synthesised with the assistance of artificial intelligence, drawing from publicly available historical records, academic publications, and cultural archives. As with any historical resource, we recommend verifying facts that matter most to your research or understanding against independent sources.

I · How It's Used Compilation, Not Invention

Drawing from the historical record

Publicly available sources, brought together in one voice

Each page on Dakhni.org is compiled from publicly available historical records, academic publications, and cultural archives, and synthesised with the assistance of artificial intelligence into a single, consistent voice. The aim is to gather scattered scholarship on the Deccan into one accessible place, not to introduce new historical claims of its own.

II · What This Means for Readers Good Practice, Not a Special Caveat

Accuracy is the goal — verification is always welcome

We recommend verifying important facts against independent sources

Every effort is made to ensure accuracy, drawing on established historical scholarship. For facts that matter most to your research or understanding, we recommend verifying independently against primary sources — sound practice for any historical resource, not a special caveat about this one.

III · Independence An Independent Project

Not affiliated with any institution

A personal cultural project, not an official record

Dakhni.org is an independent cultural project, not affiliated with any institution or government body. It exists to preserve and share the heritage of the Deccan, not to serve as an official or authoritative record.
